steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and 23 contact hours of project management education—no prior work experience needed. This makes CAPM ideal for career-changers and early-career professionals in Wichita's aerospace, healthcare, and government sectors seeking formal credentials without a lengthy employment track record.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp format. Our intensive course delivers all required education in an accelerated schedule, allowing you to move toward certification quickly while balancing your current work and responsibilities.

steps_items.heading: Submit PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal application to PMI and pay the exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance through each requirement to ensure your application meets PMI standards and moves forward without delay.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Leverage Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and review sessions to build confidence. Our instructors—active certified practitioners—equip you with strategies and knowledge to perform your best on exam day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM is valid for three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteering, or professional involvement to renew your credential and stay current with project management best practices and industry evolving standards.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
